basics.name: Roger Li
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with a background in bioengineering research and product management. I build across the stack and do my best work on the frontend, where product sense matters most; the PM years mean I can run the roadmap and client conversations too.

work.name: Oscar
highlights: Built data analysis and reporting interfaces used by hundreds of people at large government clients, enabling more complex analysis by chaining one query’s output into the next and drawing regions on a map to explore the data inside them

Owned features from the React/TypeScript frontend through the API layer: wrote Elasticsearch queries directly and added API-layer transformations over ClickHouse data so that logic stayed out of the frontend
Helped build and enforce the team’s design system (Tailwind, Base UI), and built app-wide dark mode by reworking the color system into semantic tokens compatible with shadcn conventions
Used Claude Code to build UI features and end-to-end test coverage, and helped introduce new skills and workflows that let the team keep up with a much larger throughput of code

work.name: Jumbo
highlights: Led the shift from a consumer iOS app with thousands of users to a B2B2C model serving business partners, prioritizing the protection of existing users’ data throughout
Set weekly roadmaps for a 5-person engineering team and used analytics to steer feature decisions toward KPI goals across about a dozen iOS releases

work.name: VidMob
highlights: Planned the roadmap across 3 teams as both product owner and scrum master
Worked directly with clients, using their feedback and usage data to prioritize the backlog

work.name: VidMob
highlights: Built proofs of concept so product teams could see what a feature would cost before committing to it
Overhauled the API documentation and launched a public-facing version, giving partners and prospects a self-serve reference
Technical lead for partnerships, scoping new integrations

work.name: VidMob
highlights: Built about a dozen integrations with ad platforms and business tools (Facebook, Google, Salesforce, and others) using OAuth1/OAuth2, replacing manual handoffs with automated syncs
Rebuilt the email notification system and designed and built other features end to end in Groovy/Grails

work.name: Epic Systems
highlights: Guided healthcare organizations through EHR rollouts, recommending configurations to fit clinical workflows and meeting fixed go-live dates

work.name: Healmet

work.name: University Hospitals Cleveland Medical Center

projects.name: MTA Train Board
